news.headline: Central Florida Thu Nov 26 midday: NWS Melbourne River Flood Warning remains in effect, with a Rip Current Statement through Fri 1 AM and a Small Craft Advisory through Thu 7 PM — Melbourne at noon mostly cloudy 67°F, wind W 17 mph gusting 27 mph, rain chance about 1%, Thu high 70°F / low 54°F

Florida construction Nov 26 — Four West Developers selected MGM Construction Group as general contractor for SQUARE Hallandale, an 8-story Class A office condominium at 400 West Hallandale Beach Boulevard in Hallandale Beach; the $90 million development will encompass nearly 360,000 square feet

Florida housing Nov 26 — construction is complete on 2200 Brickell, a 5-story condominium at 2200 Brickell Avenue in Miami; the building received its final certificate of occupancy on November 10 and yields 103 condominium residences, developed by Aria Development Group, Largo and Place Projects, with Ortega Construction as general contractor

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition

Copper steadies Thu Nov 26 after sharp drop — ScrapMonster (market data Nov 25): North American clean copper grades slipped another 1 cent/lb after a 25 cent/lb drop Nov 24, E.C. Aluminum Wire gained 1 cent/lb, and LME copper stood at $11,758 per metric tonne, down 2.46% on the day; U.S. copper futures rebounded 0.74% Thu to $5.3760/lb from an 11-month low

HVAC Nov 25 — ACHR News: heat pumps rose from about 28% of new homes in 2022 to nearly 48% in partial-year 2026 in a HERS dataset of more than 2.1 million rated homes, and AHRI put heat pumps at 44.7% of combined cooling equipment shipments in August 2026, up from 31% in August 2016

Markets closed Thu Nov 26 for Thanksgiving — U.S. stock and bond markets are closed Thu and reopen Fri with an early 1 PM ET stock close; Wednesday's close was mixed: S&P 500 fell 0.25% to 7,182, Dow gained 0.33% to 50,182 and Nasdaq fell 0.62% to 23,585, with markets pricing a near-certain Fed rate hike at the Dec 8-9 meeting
news.source: Investor's Business Daily / IC Markets / Morningstar

news.headline: FHFA Nov 24: the 2027 conforming loan limit for one-unit properties rises to $855,400 in most of the U.S., up $22,650 (2.72%) from 2026, with a high-cost ceiling of $1,283,100; limits will be higher in all but 24 counties, reflecting the rise in average U.S. home values between Q3 2025 and Q3 2026

NBA — Detroit Pistons beat the Orlando Magic 104-86, handing Orlando its first NBA Cup loss, and the Philadelphia 76ers beat the Miami Heat 111-104 on Wed Nov 25 in NBA Cup play (Heat now 10-7); next: Heat at the New York Knicks Fri Nov 27, Magic at the Washington Wizards Sat Nov 28

NFL Thanksgiving Thu Nov 26 — Bears at Lions 1 PM ET, Eagles at Cowboys 4:30 PM ET and Chiefs at Bills 8:20 PM ET; no Florida team plays on Thanksgiving (Jacksonville remains the only active franchise never to play on the holiday) — ahead: Jets at Dolphins and Titans at Jaguars Sun Nov 29 at 1 PM ET, Panthers at Buccaneers Mon Nov 30 at 8:15 PM ET
